# Local runtime libraries

`gsap.min.js` and `Flip.min.js` are unmodified GSAP **3.13.0** distribution files from the pinned npm package. Their original copyright/license headers are retained.

GSAP uses its [Standard no-charge license](https://gsap.com/standard-license/), as declared by its npm package. [Official repository](https://github.com/greensock/GSAP). No network request is needed by the finished artifact.

Playwright 1.55.0 is a development dependency for the browser checks, not loaded by the page.
